capabilities: Plan books, scenes, characters, and timelines
Draft chapters and compile Markdown manuscripts
Review prose rhythm, grammar, and versions
Organize notes with tasks, calendars, and workspaces
Use optional AI, translation, and read-aloud tools
disambiguation: Not a minimal plugin; it is a broad writing suite with optional modules.
extras: Large all-in-one suite with optional modules; API keys are stored in local plugin settings rather than an encrypted vault, and external AI, grammar, speech, and translation services can transmit note text.
problem: Obsidian lacks an integrated environment for planning, drafting, revising, and compiling long-form writing.
